narrative: The writing-tables on the desk. Two short lines in his hand, and nothing under them. The stylus set down beside the leaf. The parcel still tied, on the chest, out of the centre. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two lines, and left the rest of the leaf empty.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Named in yesterday's letter for the ladder and the rope. Not in the room.
